decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks fit the existing dental lab channel and carry low continuation cost, so the option remains worth keeping while demand uncertainty is unresolved.
PETG blanks support the firm's digital manufacturing shift and clear aligner workflows, making the option strategically valuable and too early to abandon.
UV-curing lacquer is a non-core chemical with likely higher regulatory and inventory costs, and its weak website presence suggests limited traction, so the option can be dropped.
Intraoral contrast spray enables digital impression workflows and aligns with digital manufacturing, so the firm should preserve this option.
The custom earmold product line leverages the firm's custom manufacturing base for hearing-care retailers, and its uncertainty still warrants holding the option despite moderate costs.
Custom hearing protection earmolds reuse existing earmold capabilities and serve a niche but growing segment, so the low-cost option is worth keeping.
